title: Quarantine table & poison-file handling

user_story.i_want: bad records kept with a reason, and repeatedly failing files isolated in a DLQ
user_story.so_that: nothing is silently lost and one bad file never blocks the queue

description: Add a migration for `stratum.quarantine` (id, file_id, line_no, source_id, name, reason, raw_text, created_at). `raw_text` is text, not jsonb, so invalid JSON is kept exactly. Use stable reason codes: unknown_source, source_disabled, unknown_name, invalid_payload, missing_required_field, decode_error. Insert in bulk with UNNEST arrays. When the handler Rejects, the ledger becomes `failed` with last_error and attempts (from the receive count), and the message reaches the DLQ after maxReceiveCount. Add `stratum-cli quarantine summary --since 1h` with counts by reason and source.

acceptance_criteria.given: a fixture file triggering every reason code

acceptance_criteria.then: the ledger row is failed with last_error and the message is in raw-files-dlq
raw_text equals the original line byte-for-byte

rust_concepts: Vec of structs to column vectors
